about: Build-time embedding mutants. The focused unit runner runs the named sketchfront tests; runtime tree-prefix behavior is also exercised by the embedded-assets example.

mutants.name: ll1-prune-off
mutants.rule: ergo test rewrites the ledger to exactly the current laws' entries: a renamed or deleted law's entry goes.

mutants.name: ll1-site-position
mutants.from: File: file, Line: line, Column: col,
mutants.rule: ergo inspect names each rewrite site by its source position.

mutants.name: ll1-stale-accepted
mutants.from: case e.digest(key, law, prov, entry.Instances) != entry.Digest:
mutants.to: case false && e.digest(key, law, prov, entry.Instances) != entry.Digest:
mutants.rule: An entry whose digest is not the one the sources give is stale: the site keeps the reference lowering (plan-2 §3).

mutants.name: ll1-digest-misses-callee
mutants.rule: The digest covers every function the provider's operations reach, at any depth.

mutants.name: ll1-digest-whole-package
mutants.rule: An edit the law does not reach leaves the entry current: ergo test changes 0 entries.

mutants.name: ll1-build-writes
mutants.rule: Only ergo test writes ergo.laws; the run build reads it and never runs a law for evidence.

mutants.name: ll1-instance-not-in-digest
mutants.rule: The digest covers the entry's instance set: a constant added to the line by hand is stale.

mutants.name: ll1-std-ledger-not-fresh
mutants.to: func Ledger() string { return ledger + "law json.Text.SepDue for json.text proved 4 states h1:AAAA\n" }
mutants.rule: The checked-in std ledger is the one a fresh run writes (go run ./scripts/stdlaws).

mutants.name: ps1-front-refutation-falls-back
mutants.rule: A reachable proof counterexample fails ergo test's ledger writer, which writes no entry (runtime.md, Tests 10).

mutants.name: lr3a-inspect-no-rewrite
mutants.rule: ergo inspect lists each rewrite site with its law, provider, verdict and ledger state (runtime.md, Tests 10; docs/tooling.md, inspect).

mutants.name: lr3a-inspect-applied
mutants.rule: A site whose entry is stale, missing or not proved is never applied, and inspect says so (owner q115, q122).

mutants.name: lr3a-check-reason
mutants.rule: ergo check's evaluation skips a rewrite law with its verdict: tested, its run's bounds, not applied (owner q115).
